candidate_status: Specific unverified name, not asserted to exist or match Mara. Selected for one exact metadata inquiry, not from an observed candidate image.
usable_outcome: If exactly present and later fully source/image reviewed, an isolated source-owned material reference packet could supply a concrete facial-detail input for a later complete Mara master. First phase only selects exact availability; it does not qualify skin/face or authorize extraction/native work.
bounded_question: Does the already frozen517member ZIP-MANIFEST contain exactly this literal named material with valid ordinary-file metadata? No substring, alternatefilename, agecategory, source/capability census or asset hunt.
decision: Exact one matching safe entry can justify a separate source-read/view contract for that material and only its literal linked texture. Zero/ambiguous/invalid match stops this packet before member decode. A name cannot determine perceived age/gender/skin identity or suitability.
why_consequential: Previous Mara source-path review identifies missing selected facial form/material master. This names one concrete potential material input, preserving separate form/UV/rest-expression/ocular/auxiliary/rig/expression duties rather than running age labels. Exact availability can decide whether this named source is a viable next owner.

alternatives.choice: One exact frozen-manifest lookup of the named candidate
alternatives.tradeoff: Very small source-owned inquiry may identify a real material; absent/ambiguous match yields no asset, and presence alone yields no appearance qualification. Preferred only if critic judges useful.

alternatives.choice: Defer until a different actually selected complete face/material source is supplied
alternatives.tradeoff: Avoids speculative filename lookup but leaves this concrete available archive untested; no generic hunt or invented face contract follows.

if_worth_A_only.operation: Parse pinned existing ZIP-MANIFEST JSON and inspect its schema plus exact member equality; retain exact requested name and all matching metadata in RESULT.json. No ZIP/archive member read, download, native/model/target/image decode, APIs, renderer, new image or source/default change.
if_worth_A_only.limit: One metadata inquiry under5seconds; manifest<=2MiB; output<=16KiB; stop on no exact unique safe match. No query correction/alternate spelling/refetch or successor recipe. Ordinary current-byte input hashes allowed.
if_worth_A_only.future_stage: Any material/member/linked-texture source/image inquiry needs a new explicit bounded contract and critic/root review. Do not extract or choose native values now.

preservation: Full22scoped/10broad character/representation/expression/wardrobe/physicalfit/motion/performance/VTuber/Mii/AAA roadmap retained. All closed native/CPU/sourcecollector/localnumeric/groom/parameter/brief/Mara-capture routes stay closed. No source repair, generic asset hunt, push/publish/purchase/reset/model/subscription/install/otherproject. Existing critic and ACTIVE10minuteheartbeat retained; humancheckin/pausewins.
